column1: # ZAP baseline rule tuning. Format: <rule id> <TAB> <IGNORE|WARN|FAIL> <TAB> <reason>
# The CI gate (deploy/scripts/zap-gate.sh) fails on any alert of risk Medium or higher that is not
# IGNOREd here. An entry needs a reason a reviewer can disagree with.
# Informational rules that fire on any JSON API and carry no action for this service:

column3: (Storable and Cacheable Content) informational; API responses carry no secrets and the auth header is required for data
(Timestamp Disclosure) informational; JSON responses include ISO dates by design
